hooks.text: 没有固定玩家角色，敌方机器人都能成为临时宿主，并以各自招式、流派和升级体系继续战斗。
hooks.excerpt: Every enemy is a potential host. Switch control at a moment’s notice between unique enemy types, each with a distinct moveset and playstyle, and their own arsenal of upgrades to unlock.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战斗风格分直接充当局内货币，熟练技巧和花式射击可换取改变各类宿主运作方式的升级。
hooks.excerpt: RAM expands the style systems seen in games like Devil May Cry and Ultrakill by making style points in-run currency. Master combat techniques and execute trickshots to earn a diverse array of upgrades that modify how each host robot functions, then pit your accumulated strength against dangerous bosses with their own unique swap-related mechanics.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 玩家将穿越人类废墟中的程序生成关卡，面对在末日后崛起的古怪机械社会。
hooks.excerpt: Traverse the ruins of the human world across multiple procedurally-generated levels, and contend with the eccentric mechanical societies that have risen to inhabit them.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
